entries.rationale: Shared stateless Full Newton loop and diagnostics are the closest current authoritative-driver foundation; evolve behind the new contract.

Retain continuation mathematics as a driver mode, but share transaction, diagnostics and failure policy.

Retain bounded frictionless penalty calculations; express diagnostics/admissibility and optional future state via ContactContribution.
Legacy global active-set ownership is retained without promotion until a safe common-driver adaptation is separately contracted.
Active-set/fixed-point/semi-smooth loops and slip state remain research compatibility; WP01 creates no frictional integration.
Retain storage-neutral persistence boundary but evolve payload/validation in later work to the unified state schema.
Keep compatibility until the shared line-search dispatch has passed WP01/WP03 gates; do not remove in WP01-A.
Compatibility wrapper already delegates to shared semantics; retain temporarily and remove only after public compatibility audit.
